scope: Tracked and new documentation/Spec Kit + selected Context source/test evidence. Excludes raw private secrets, node_modules, large binaries and handoff itself.

hashSemantics.sha256NormalizedLF: UTF-8 contents with CRLF canonicalized to LF; cross-Windows/Linux portable
hashSemantics.sha256RawG6: Original G6 checkout physical byte SHA256 at collection
hashSemantics.gitBlobSha1: Exact Git committed blob for git-tracked files only

commitStatus.localOnlyPolicy: Preserve in private local archives. Do not push raw untracked/ignored reports to GitHub without content/security review.
